_diagChecks: What /diag probes live from the visitor's browser (scripts/publish_webgl.ps1 writes diag.html from scripts/webgl/diag.html). kind: page (this build's page), commit (X-Commit header), webgl2, off (switched off on purpose: neutral 'Off', not counted in the banner); otherwise url is fetched with latency (expect json/jsonKey or a text it must contain). One HEAD check per Build/ file is added by the script.
